slides.body: Barnes & Noble opens today at 10 a.m. at 3201 N. Miami Ave., Ste. 111, Miami. L.J. Shen is doing the ribbon-cutting and book signing.

slides.body: The 10th anniversary edition runs Oct. 13 to 18 in Miami. WSVN says the week includes a special pop-up to meet designers.

slides.headline: Luminosa at Jungle Island, this week
slides.body: Jungle Island’s 1.35-mile light trail has seven zones, food vendors, cocktails and live entertainment. Tickets are 10% off when booked by Oct. 18.
